_comment: REVIEWED BY HAND. Enumerated from live Overture data, then curated — substring matching over-captures in ways only a person catches (see excluded_notable). Regenerate candidates with: python scripts/overture_extract.py --enumerate
_icp: Local home-services businesses that dispatch on inbound phone calls — the ICP an AI receptionist serves. Not retail, not automotive, not healthcare, not personal care.

excluded_notable.dry_cleaning: matches 'clean' but is a storefront, not a home service — the documented trap (1,002 rows)
excluded_notable.hair_salon: personal services, not a dispatched trade (11,013 rows — the single biggest false positive)
excluded_notable.automotive_repair: auto trade is a different ICP with different call patterns (12,398 rows)
excluded_notable.home_health_care: healthcare — different regulatory surface entirely, do not cold-mail
excluded_notable.home_improvement_store: RETAIL. A store has a counter, not a dispatch board. Same for carpet/flooring/paint/appliance/home-goods stores
excluded_notable.home_developer: homebuilders/developers sell projects, they do not dispatch service calls
excluded_notable.it_service_and_computer_repair: real inbound-call business but a different ICP; revisit as its own vertical
excluded_notable.water_supplier: utility, not a service business (same for electric/electricity suppliers)
excluded_notable.swimming_pool: the facility, not the service — pool_cleaning and pool_and_hot_tub_services carry the trade
